key_facts: Blurry vision in right eye for several months
Anastrozole therapy for more than 2 years
Conjunctival injection and fine keratic precipitates in right eye
Cystoid macular edema with yellow spot in fovea in right eye
No peripheral inflammation in either eye
Normal blood tests for vasculitis and rheumatologic disorders

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of blurry vision, cystoid macular edema with a yellow spot in the fovea in the right eye, and significant cystoid macular edema and subfoveal fluid on OCT scans, along with leakage on fluorescein angiography, strongly supports this diagnosis

rejected.label: Uveitis
rejected.why: While the patient has a history of bilateral iritis, the current presentation is more specifically explained by cystoid macular edema

rejected.label: Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: Normal blood tests for vasculitis and rheumatologic disorders make this less likely

rejected.label: Fuchs Heterochromic Iridocyclitis
rejected.why: The patient's presentation does not include heterochromia of the iris

rejected.label: Herpes Simplex Iridocyclitis
rejected.why: There is no mention of a history of herpes simplex infection or characteristic dendritic ulcers

rejected.label: Toxoplasmosis
rejected.why: The patient's presentation and imaging do not suggest a toxoplasmosis infection

rejected.label: Vogt-Koyanagi-Harada Disease
rejected.why: The patient's presentation lacks the characteristic skin, hair, and auditory findings of this disease
